name: Vector Workflows
description: A one-person automation and web engineering studio building backend systems, messaging bots, telephony pipelines and hand-built websites for small service businesses.
whatsapp_text: Hi, saw Vector Workflows — I'd like to ask about automation for my business.

services.name: Web Presence
services.summary: A fast, static website written by hand: no page builder, no platform fee, nothing to break when a framework moves on.
includes: A hand-built static website, written without a page builder
Mobile-first layout that stays fast on slow connections
WhatsApp, call and email links wired into every page
The full source handed over to you
excludes: Copywriting or photography beyond what you provide
Content changes after hand-over, quoted separately

services.name: Lead Capture
services.summary: Every enquiry caught, acknowledged and sent to the place you actually look, with a list you can work through.
includes: An intake form or step-by-step flow on your site
Enquiries routed to WhatsApp, Telegram, email or a Google Sheet
An automatic acknowledgement to the person enquiring
A lead list you can sort, update and follow up from

services.name: Booking & Automation
services.summary: The repetitive admin between a booking and a finished job, handled by a system that runs the same way every time.
includes: A booking or scheduling flow tied to your calendar
Confirmations and reminders by message or email
One back-office workflow automated end to end, such as logging jobs to a sheet
Set-up on a cloud server so it runs around the clock
excludes: Connecting to tools that offer no API

services.name: Voice & Messaging
services.tagline: IVR, missed-call response, WhatsApp and Telegram bots
services.summary: Your phone line and chat apps doing the first response for you: missed calls answered, messages logged, you alerted.
includes: Missed-call auto-response by SMS or WhatsApp
A WhatsApp or Telegram bot built around one core task
A simple IVR menu and call routing
Alerts to you on Telegram, logged to a Google Sheet
excludes: Telephony and messaging provider usage, billed at cost

systems.name: Missed Lead Responder
systems.line: A missed call becomes an instant SMS reply, an owner alert and a logged lead.
systems.stack: Twilio · FastAPI · MongoDB · Telegram · Google Sheets

systems.name: Site Fault Tracker
systems.line: A WhatsApp photo and a short note become one structured row in the team's sheet.
systems.stack: WhatsApp Cloud API · Python · Vision model · Google Sheets

systems.name: Dynamic Scheduler
systems.line: Send /awake and today's schedule switches to the template that matches when your day started.
systems.stack: Telegram Bot API · Python · Google Calendar
